claim_boundary: 300 道保留题的固定参考剂量确认；旧未干预输出已观察，独立性限于新干预效果。18 项预登记对比统一 Holm 校正，次要消融仅作描述；一个 SAE/生成 seed，不代表跨 seed 稳定性、推理语义确认或统一学生蒸馏已完成。

confirmation_plan.multiplicity: Holm across all 18 two-sided tests; no subgroup/metric removal
confirmation_plan.length_test: paired-label sign randomization under within-question label-exchangeability; plus-one correction for Monte Carlo; exact enumeration when <=16 nonzero pairs
confirmation_plan.secondary: All 64-question feature-count/window comparisons and answer-region marker/suffix statistics are descriptive; marginal bootstrap intervals are not simultaneous tests.
confirmation_plan.selection: Original mechanism input rho_reference=0.3; no dose optimization on confirmation. All six original directions retained.
confirmation_plan.prior_exposure: These reserved train questions already have an unmodified baseline generated and uniformly graded. They have not contributed to direction fitting, development dose selection, or intervention-effect analysis. Independence is limited to that held-out intervention scope.
confirmation_plan.seed_scope: One historical SAE and one paired per-question generation seed; additional SAE seeds remain a separate stage.
